title: Clicking "New inherited" on an imported GLTF mesh crashes the editor
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot v4.5.dev (5e27318b6)

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (5e27318b6) - macOS Sequoia (15.4.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M3 Pro (12 threads)

### Issue description

Attempting to click "New inherited scene" on an imported GLTF mesh after clicking "Open in Editor" in the scene hierarchy crashes the editor with the following stack trace:

This may or may not be caused by #106121 

### Steps to reproduce

- Open the attached MRP
- In the scene tree pane on the "weird_tower" node, press "Open in Editor"
- In the popup select "New inherited"
